answer: Ephemeral challenge binding: each identity must submit a fresh proof derived from a per-epoch randomness kernel that the network publishes only after registration closes, so a precomputed answer cannot be reused. The rule: valid proofs must embed that kernel and a timestamp, and a ripple of duplicate proofs triggers rejection of the whole registration batch. An attacker must run a distinct full voyage of computation for every identity each epoch, paying real compute and latency per unit rather than replaying one answer,
